units.source_text: 驹子无可奈何似地无言可对，默默地闭上了眼睛，

en.t: Komako, helpless and unable to answer, silently closed her eyes,

units.source_text: 心想：岛村自然会把自己挂在心上的吧？

en.t: thinking: Shimamura would surely keep her in his heart, wouldn't he?

units.source_text: 于是她显出一副通情达理的样子说：

en.t: Then she put on an understanding air and said:
